# PogCut

> PogCut turns Twitch streamers' VODs into vertical, captioned highlight clips for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. It uses Twitch chat reactions plus AI review of the transcript to find funny and hype moments automatically.

## Key facts
- Audience: Twitch streamers who want short-form clips without editing.
- Clip details: vertical 9:16 1080p, burned-in captions, suggested title and hook per clip; highlight detection uses chat activity including BTTV/7TV/FFZ emotes plus the transcript.
- How it works: 1) streamer opts in with their Twitch channel, 2) PogCut finds chat-reaction spikes and AI picks real highlights, 3) streamer receives a pack of 9:16 captioned clips (webcam top, gameplay bottom).
- Consent: only channels whose owners opt in are processed. PogCut never posts to the streamer's accounts.
- Pricing: free beta with an early-access waitlist.
- Platforms: Twitch first.
- Website: https://pogcut.github.io/

## Pages
- [Home](https://pogcut.github.io/): overview, how it works, what a clip pack includes, pricing, FAQ, signup
- [Guide: turn a Twitch VOD into TikTok, Shorts and Reels clips](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/twitch-vod-to-tiktok/): step-by-step manual method, plus how PogCut automates it
- [Guide: Twitch clip titles and hooks](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/twitch-clip-titles-hooks/): how to write the first 2 seconds, on-screen text and curiosity-gap titles for stream highlights, with title templates
- [Guide: find the best moments in a Twitch VOD](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/find-twitch-vod-highlights/): using chat spikes, BTTV/7TV/FFZ emote bursts, audio and the transcript to find highlights, and why clips should start before the chat spike
- [Guide: add word-by-word captions to Twitch clips for free](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/caption-twitch-clips/): transcribe with open-source Whisper using word timestamps, style an .ass subtitle file, and burn captions in with FFmpeg
- [Guide: stack webcam over gameplay in a vertical Twitch clip](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/webcam-gameplay-vertical-layout/): crop math for 1080x1920, a free FFmpeg crop/scale/vstack command, safe zones, and layouts for streams without a facecam
- [Guide: download your Twitch VOD before it expires](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/download-twitch-vod/): Twitch VOD retention (7/14/60 days), downloading from the Video Producer, and saving only the highlight section with yt-dlp --download-sections
- [Guide: post Twitch clips as YouTube Shorts](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/twitch-clips-youtube-shorts/): the 3-minute Shorts limit, a free FFmpeg command for 1080x1920 60fps vertical export, and why copyright-claimed music blocks Shorts over one minute
- [Guide: post Twitch clips as Instagram Reels](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/twitch-clips-instagram-reels/): Reels up to 20 minutes but only up to 3 minutes recommended to new audiences, 9:16 1080x1920 size (30fps/720p minimum), a tested FFmpeg 60fps vertical export command, and caption placement
- [Guide: how to clip on Twitch](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/how-to-clip-on-twitch/): making clips up to 60 seconds from live streams or VODs, Stacked/Full portrait layouts in the Clips Manager, direct sharing to TikTok/YouTube/Instagram/Snapchat, and joining two clips with FFmpeg for longer moments
- [All guides](https://pogcut.github.io/guides/): index of PogCut guides for Twitch streamers
